slides.headline:
26 theme packs.
*Five jobs.*
slides.deck: Grouped by the job each pack does, not the way it looks. The figure on every row is the slide types it handles.
Built to be *saved and returned to*, not read once.

items.name: catalogue
items.body: *Ten to a page*, numbered across the deck.

items.name: audit
items.body: One whole system on *one dense card*.

items.name: index-rail
items.body: A link roundup with *a numbered rail*.

items.name: manifest
items.body: A counted taxonomy, *a metric per row*.

slides.deck: Decks that *take a position* and invite a reply.

items.name: versus
items.body: A real before and after. *The split moves.*

items.name: swap
items.body: Paid versus free, *one row at a time*.

items.name: tierlist
items.body: A ranking *built to be argued with*.

slides.deck: For content that only makes sense *in order*.

items.name: vintage-print
items.body: The *reveal* — one step lit per slide.

items.name: thread
items.body: A session that *builds up line by line*.

slides.deck: When the honest answer to *what does it look like* is a drawing.

items.name: briefing
items.body: *One exhibit per slide*, drawn from data.

slides.deck: Packs that sound like *a person made them*.

items.name: handbuilt
items.body: A build log *in your own voice*.

items.name: notebook-tabs
items.body: An inset card and *a file-tab strip*.

slides.headline:
Pick the *shape*,
not the palette.
slides.body: Match a pack to what the content is doing. Colour is the last decision, and the one that matters least.
